newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley on DuPont.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley on DuPont.

text.p: Morgan Stanley analyst Leslie Ravitz cited the strong earnings outlook in DuPont Co's life sciences business in his upgrade of the stock.
-- earlier Morgan Stanley said it raised DuPont to strong buy from outperform, with a $68 price target.

-- the life sciences business, including pharmaceutical sales and agricultural products, will push DuPont's 1999 earnings over $4.50 a share "even in a mediocre (but not recessionary) economic environment," the analyst said in a report.
-- estimates DuPont will earn $3.65 in 1997 and $4.00 in 1998.
